business.what_it_does: Fluorination-chemistry manufacturer running four verticals: HPP (HFC refrigerants including R32, plus a new AHF facility), Specialty Chemicals (multi-purpose plant capacity at Dahej, Nectar project), CDMO (cGMP plants making molecules for pharma customers) and an emerging Advanced Materials business aimed at data centres, electronics, semiconductors and defence. H1 FY27 PAT crossed INR500 crore. The inputs give no revenue split by segment.

segments.name: HPP (HFC / R32 / AHF)
segments.comment: Volumes and realisations both up in Q2 FY27, HFC pricing firm and up sequentially. A 15,000 MT R32 expansion is due to commission in Q3 FY27 and fully ramp in Q4 FY27.

segments.name: Specialty Chemicals
segments.comment: Dahej MPP debottlenecking was commissioned in September 2026. Management says it is not yet in the numbers. Nectar is to run at 60-65% of PAR in FY27, with the balance in FY28.

segments.name: CDMO
segments.comment: 5 new molecules have campaign orders running to year-end and beyond. cGMP-4 Phase 2 (INR125 crore) is due by Q4 FY27, and Phase 5 will be triggered at 70-80% utilisation. Target of USD100 million by FY27.

segments.name: Advanced Materials
segments.comment: New vertical with an INR90 crore capacity capex due by Q2 FY28. Targeted at 10-15% of the enlarged business by 2030.

credibility.label: medium
credibility.summary: Management guides margins low and beats them: FY26 came in at 32.7% against a 30% guide, and the last four quarters ran at 34.2-34.5%. Project dates are less reliable: Chemours slipped from end-Q2 FY27 to Q3 FY27, and the inputs cannot test the large targets (USD100 million CDMO, cGMP-4 at INR900-1,000 crore, Nectar PAR).

promises.evidence: FY27 capex guide of about INR700 crore. FY27 is half over and the facts include no capex-to-date figure.
Check: FY26 EBITDA margin was 32.7% against a 30% +/-200 bps guide. That is 70 bps above the top of the band, a beat rather than a narrow hit.
INR900-1,000 crore peak revenue from cGMP-4 Phases 1 and 2 by FY28-FY29. Phase 2 is not due until Q4 FY27 (G3), and the inputs report no CDMO revenue.

The 30% long-term margin guide was kept in Q2 FY27, while margins over the last four quarters were 34.5/34.2/34.2/34.2% (TTM 34.3%). Delivery sits about 430 bps above the guide, which reads as a conservative floor.

Q1 FY27 guided Phase 2 cGMP-4 (INR125 crore, internal accruals) to be operational by Q4 FY27. The Q2 FY27 call repeated the same date (G3), and C2 says warehouse and ETP infrastructure is already built ahead of later phases. No progress metric is given.
Check: the FY27 margin to date (2 of 4 quarters) is 34.2% against a guide of about 30% +/-1-2%. H2 would have to fall below roughly 26-30% to miss.
Q3 FY27 commissioning date for Chemours. The quarter runs to December 2026 and no later update exists. This date is already a one-quarter slip from the end-Q2 FY27 target given in Q1 FY27 (G16).
Advanced materials capacity is due by Q2 FY28, and no progress update appears in the context.
cGMP-4 Phase 2 is due to be operational by end-Q4 FY27. This was stated in the latest call, and no later signal exists.
Management says USD100 million by FY27 is on time. The facts include no CDMO revenue, and C2's wording ('starting to knocking that door very soon') is looser than a full-year commitment.
Nectar is to reach 60-65% of PAR in FY27 (restated in C3/C9). FY27 has not ended and no utilisation data is provided.

Aspiration of 20-25% a year to 2030. Revenue YoY over the last four quarters was 47.2/33.8/44.1/57.1%, above the band. The 3y revenue CAGR is 16.9%, below the band, so the current run-rate partly reflects a recovery from a weak base. The 5y CAGR of 23.0% is within the band.
The board approved INR90 crore of adoption-capacity capex with no spend horizon. The linked commissioning date is Q2 FY28 (G2).
Full R32 ramp is due in Q4 FY27. C8 says ramp-up starts towards the end of Q3, with full ramp 'possibly' next quarter. The plant had not been commissioned at the time of the call (C5, C7).
The facts have no EBITDA-to-cash conversion figure. CFO/PAT averaged 1.2x over 5 years, which is a different basis and cannot be compared to a 60-65% EBITDA conversion.
The latest cash conversion cycle is 60 days, down from 193 days three years ago and inside the 70-75 day ceiling. Management's working-capital definition may differ from the computed CCC.
Advanced Materials is targeted at 10-15% of revenue by 2030. Its capacity is not commissioned until Q2 FY28 (G2), and no segment revenue is reported.
The target is more than 60% of energy from renewables. It has no date, and the inputs contain no energy-mix data.
Q1 FY27 targeted Chemours completion by end-Q2 FY27. The Q2 FY27 call says it is 'progressing towards commissioning in Q3 FY27' (G1), so it slipped at least one quarter.
promises.actual: Not completed by end-Q2 FY27; re-guided to Q3 FY27

promises.evidence: The Q2 FY27 call says the HFC/R32 expansion 'remains on track for commissioning shortly' (C4, C5), with ramp-up beginning late in the current quarter (C8). Q3 FY27 is still in progress.
Dahej MPP debottlenecking was commissioned in September 2026 (C4, C6), within Q2 FY27 and ahead of the Q3 FY27 target. C7 says its output is not yet in the reported numbers.
Target of 3x asset turn on the INR288 crore capex by FY29. That is three years away, and the inputs do not report asset turn for this project.
The Q1 FY27 'very much on track' claim for USD100 million was repeated in Q2 FY27 (G5). This is management's word only: the inputs report no CDMO revenue to check it.

Guide of 32-33% +/-1%. Margins over the last three quarters were 34.2% each, just above the 34% top of the band. This sits alongside a separate 30% guide (G9, G34) restated one call later, so two different margin anchors are in use.
promises.actual: 34.2% in each of the last three quarters

narrative_vs_numbers.claim: Management refuses to lift margin guidance: 'We are not going to change the guidance from 30%'.
narrative_vs_numbers.reality: EBITDA margin was 34.5/34.2/34.2/34.2% over the last four quarters (TTM 34.3%), FY26 was 32.7%, and the 3y expansion is 610 bps. The guide sits about 430 bps below delivery.

narrative_vs_numbers.claim: Healthy growth from higher HPP volumes and realisations and from specialty order visibility.
narrative_vs_numbers.reality: Revenue YoY accelerated to 57.1% in Q2 FY27 (from 33.8-47.2% in the prior three quarters), and PAT rose 81.8% YoY. The margin held flat at 34.2% for three quarters, so the gain is coming from volume and price, not further margin expansion.

narrative_vs_numbers.claim: Capex (INR125 crore cGMP-4 Phase 2, INR90 crore adoption capacity) is funded from internal accruals, with INR700 crore of capex planned for FY27.
narrative_vs_numbers.reality: Cumulative 5y FCF is -INR899 crore, and borrowings are INR1,248 crore (D/E 0.28). Past capex has outrun internal cash generation even though CFO/PAT is 1.2x.

narrative_vs_numbers.claim: Aspirational growth of 20-25% a year to 2030.
narrative_vs_numbers.reality: The 5y revenue CAGR of 23.0% fits the band, but the 3y CAGR of 16.9% is below it. The current 33.8-57.1% quarterly growth rate is too recent to show the band is sustainable.

bull.point: Margins are beating guidance: 34.2-34.5% for four quarters against a 30% guide, FY26 at 32.7% against 30% +/-2%, and 610 bps of expansion over 3 years. ROCE is 21%.

Capacity not yet in the numbers: MPP debottlenecking was commissioned in September 2026, ahead of its Q3 FY27 target. 15,000 MT of R32 commissions in Q3 FY27 with full ramp in Q4 FY27. The CDMO has 5 new molecules with campaign orders beyond year-end. All of this sits on top of 57.1% revenue growth.
Working capital is tighter: the cash conversion cycle fell from 193 to 60 days over 3 years, and CFO/PAT was 1.2x over 5 years, so reported profit is converting to operating cash.

bear.point: Heavy capex is weighing on free cash: 5y FCF is -INR899 crore and borrowings are INR1,248 crore, with a further INR700 crore planned for FY27. Returns are back-ended, with 3x asset turn not targeted until FY29 and cGMP-4 at INR900-1,000 crore not until FY28-FY29.

Project dates slip, and the big targets cannot be checked: Chemours moved from end-Q2 to Q3 FY27, and the inputs report no CDMO revenue to test USD100 million by FY27. Management's wording softened from 'very much on track' to 'starting to knocking that door very soon'.

Management's own guides imply margin risk: they keep both a 30% long-term guide and a 32-33% range against a 34.2% run-rate, which points to 120-420 bps of expected compression. Margins have stopped expanding (flat at 34.2% for 3 quarters), and part of the current level rests on 'firm' HFC realisations.

questions: What was H1 FY27 CDMO revenue in USD? Does 'knocking that door very soon' mean USD100 million of FY27 revenue or only an exit run-rate?

Margins have held at 34.2-34.5% for four quarters. Which part of that do you expect to lose to reach your 30% long-term and 32-33% guides: HFC realisations, product mix, or new-capacity start-up costs?
What delayed Chemours from end-Q2 to Q3 FY27, and has it now been commissioned? With 5y FCF at -INR899 crore, how much of the INR700 crore FY27 capex will internal accruals actually fund?
